# hivemind_forager_base_images (Data Source)

Base images in the deployment's catalog, accepted in `base_image` of environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivemind_forager_base_images" "available" {}

output "base_images" {
  value = data.hivemind_forager_base_images.available.images[*].image_ref
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) Catalog images in server order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 build timestamp. Null for built-in images.
- `image_ref` (String) Image ID used in `base_image`, e.g. `sparkbox-base://universal`.
- `name` (String) Display name, e.g. `Ubuntu`.
- `version` (String) Image version or build identifier.
